title: Capacity Conductor UI — resilience controls, throughput explorer and change trail
creator: Maya Chen
description: Add a focused ‘Capacity Conductor’ workspace in the Console that centralizes resilience controls (throttle presets, guaranteed throughput knobs, throttle overrides), a throughput explorer for fleet-level and pool-level telemetry, and an immutable change trail for operator actions. This is aimed at Dedicated customers to reduce incidents from sudden autoscale behavior and give operators a single place to inspect and revert capacity decisions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Operators can view and edit throttle presets and throughput guarantees for a selected capacity pool with a single-save action. 2) Throughput Explorer shows 1m/5m/1h aggregated TPS, p50/p95 latency, and request queue length with zoom and export. 3) Every UI action that changes capacity policy or presets is recorded in Change Trail with actor, diff summary, and link to rollback action. 4) Backend API endpoints exist for read/write and audit log consumption and pass security review. 5) Feature behind a console feature-flag and staged rollout for pilot customers.
proposal: Build a new Console page 'Capacity Conductor' accessible from Dedicated -> Pools. Split into three vertical panels: (A) Resilience Controls (presets + manual overrides), (B) Throughput Explorer (time-series + breakdown by model/route), (C) Change Trail (searchable audit feed). Use existing telemetry pipeline for metrics and add a lightweight audit-record write path that writes to durable event store. Provide a single REST API to apply multiple control changes atomically to avoid transient inconsistent states.
design_notes: DES to provide high-fidelity mocks for desktop and tablet. Key UX: minimize accidental large-scale changes (confirm modal with impact estimator), inline help for each preset, and a compact diff view in the Change Trail. Use color-coded badges for guarantee levels (Gold/Silver/Bronze). Attach link to initial mock: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/capacity-conductor-v1 (internal).
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (API + Telemetry): ENG to add endpoints for reading/writing presets and querying aggregated throughput stats (2 sprints). Phase 2 (UI): Implement React page, wiring to API and audit log (1 sprint). Phase 3 (Pilot + Hardening): Release feature-flagged to 3 pilot customers, collect feedback, tighten SLOs and add rollback job (1 sprint). Engineers: Arjun, Leila R., Tomas G. QA: Priya S. Security: run checklist before pilot.
rollout_notes: Feature behind 'capacityConductor' flag. Pilot rollout: enable for 3 existing Dedicated customers with pre-signed SLA. Monitor for unexpected autoscale deltas for 72h. After pilot and two-week burn-in, enable for all Dedicated accounts with opt-in. Communicate change to customers via release notes and support playbook.
test_plan: Unit tests for API, integration tests that simulate concurrent preset changes, UI end-to-end tests for making and reverting a change, and load test for Throughput Explorer queries under typical telemetry volumes. Verify audit entries include user id, timestamp, before/after snapshots and a linkable rollback action. Manual usability session with two platform operators.
